name: Tabernanthalog
summary: Tabernanthalog (TBG; developmental code name DLX-007) is a non-selective serotonin receptor modulator and putatively non-psychedelic psychoplastogen of the ibogalog group related to the iboga alkaloid tabernanthine but with a simplified chemical structure. It was developed by David E. Olson and colleagues at the University of California, Davis.

pharmacology.text: Tabernanthalog is a non-selective and non-psychedelic serotonin receptor modulator, including acting as an agonist of the serotonin 5-HT1B, 5-HT1F, 5-HT2A, 5-HT2C, and 5-HT6 receptors and as an agonist or antagonist of the serotonin 5-HT2B receptor. It also shows significant binding to the serotonin transporter (SERT) (acting as a serotonin reuptake inhibitor), the α2A-adrenergic receptor, and monoamine oxidase A (MAO-A).
pharmacology.kind: Non-selective serotonin receptor modulator; Non-hallucinogenic serotonin 5-HT2A receptor partial agonist

uses.text: It was developed by David E. Olson and colleagues at the University of California, Davis. The drug is being developed by Delix Therapeutics as a potential pharmaceutical drug for treatment of neuropsychiatric disorders.

sideEffects.en: It has not been widely tested in people, so its side effects are not well known.
sideEffects.zh: 它尚未在人體廣泛試驗，因此副作用目前所知不多。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它尚未在人体广泛试验，因此副作用目前所知不多。

fact.en: It was designed at the University of California, Davis, as a simplified, water-soluble version of the iboga alkaloids, meant to keep their effects on brain plasticity while losing the hallucinations and heart risks of ibogaine.
fact.zh: 它由加州大學戴維斯分校設計，是伊博格生物鹼的簡化水溶性版本，目的是保留它們對大腦可塑性的作用，同時去除伊博格鹼的幻覺效果與心臟風險。
fact.zhHans: 它由加州大学戴维斯分校设计，是伊博格生物碱的简化水溶性版本，目的是保留它们对大脑可塑性的作用，同时去除伊博格碱的幻觉效果与心脏风险。
